I principali spazi digitali dove la comu: The main online spaces where the Sri Lankan community in Italy shares information, posts job offers and organises events — together with the long-standing associations working on the ground.
Il principale gruppo Facebook per la dia: The main Facebook group for the Sri Lankan diaspora in Italy. Useful for finding work, bureaucratic information and events. Search "Sri Lankans in Italy" on Facebook.
📘 Community Center of Sri Lanka — Milano: 📘 Community Center of Sri Lanka — Milan (Facebook)
Gruppo di riferimento per rimanere aggio: The go-to group for keeping up with local initiatives of the Milan community. Search "Community center of srilanka" on Facebook.
Associazione attiva dal 2002, con sede i: An association active since 2002, based in Via Venini, Milan. It works on cultural mediation and support for foreign nationals in Italy. A long-standing reference point for the Sri Lankan community.
🌐 Lotus Club — giovani professionisti it: 🌐 Lotus Club — young Italian-Sri Lankan professionals
Associazione che unisce giovani professi: An association bringing together young professionals and entrepreneurs of Sri Lankan origin in Italy, aiming to strengthen cultural and economic ties between the two countries.
\"Friends of Sri Lanka\" — una delle pri: "Friends of Sri Lanka" — one of the very first Sri Lankan associations in Italy, founded in 1986. A historic pillar of the Milan community.
